mapper.select: SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, up.tag_id, st.name AS tag_name, up.create_time FROM user_preference up LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON up.category_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN scenic_tag st ON up.tag_id = st.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY up.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM user_preference up JOIN scenic s ON ( s.category_id = up.category_id OR s.id IN ( SELECT str.scenic_id FROM scenic_tag_relation str WHERE str.tag_id = up.tag_id ) ) LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 1 AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.view_count DESC, s.score DESC
SELECT COALESCE(sc.name, '未分类') AS category_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_preference up LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON up.category_id = sc.id GROUP BY up.category_id, sc.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.name, s.description, s.images, s.price, s.score, s.location, s.view_count, s.category_id, sc.name AS category_name, s.status, s.recommend_level, s.create_time FROM scenic s LEFT JOIN scenic_category sc ON s.category_id = sc.id WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.deleted = 0 AND ( s.category_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s2.category_id FROM view_record vr JOIN scenic s2 ON vr.scenic_id = s2.id WHERE vr.user_id = #{userId} AND s2.deleted = 0 ) OR s.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT str2.scenic_id FROM scenic_tag_relation str2 WHERE str2.tag_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT str.tag_id FROM view_record vr JOIN scenic_tag_relation str ON vr.scenic_id = str.scenic_id WHERE vr.user_id = #{userId} ) ) ) AND s.id NOT IN ( SELECT scenic_id FROM view_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY s.view_count DESC, s.score DESC
